source: BYOP workbook tabs 03 'ATHLETIC - FULL BODY - 4 DAYS A', 04 'JUSTICE LEAGUE', 08 'NO ACCESS - ATHLETIC - FB - 4 t' (raw/BYOP.xlsx, read-only).
counting_convention: 1 working set = 1.0 to each prime mover, 0.5 to each clear synergist; athletic (AP_*) sets reported separately as 'athletic exposure' and NOT counted toward hypertrophy volume; aerobic rows counted as bouts not sets; FOCUS sets are client-assigned (focus_flex).

programs.title: ATHLETIC - FULL BODY - 4 DAYS A WEEK
programs.goal: General athletic development (speed/power + full-body resistance); build-your-own template, nothing chosen except Monday leg-extension reps 'MYO SET'.
programs.level: not fixed - every slot exposes its library level ladder (FOUNDATIONAL / MODERATE / ADVANCED, UNILATERAL blocks); level is picked per slot
programs.equipment: full gym implied (barbell Olympic lifts, squat rack, cable stack, leg-extension and leg-curl machines, med balls, plates/hurdles/boxes, open space for COD and running)

assumptions.assumed_2sets_*: every unset slot = 2 sets (the coach's own choice on every filled JUSTICE LEAGUE slot); filled values kept
assumptions.assumed_3sets_*: every unset slot = 3 sets (generic default; also the coach's most common compound dose in AESTHETICS); filled values kept
assumptions.aerobic: 'Aerobic Capacity' rows counted as bouts, not sets (no REPS dropdown; the option text carries the dose)
assumptions.focus: 'Focus 1'/'Focus 2' sets counted under FOCUS (muscle chosen by client from AZ list)

rep_ranges_by_bucket.MYO_SET_definition: MASTER_MODEL 'ALL ABOUT SQUATS' A30: 15 reps, ~3 s pause, then 5 x 5 reps with ~3 s breaths = 40 reps ('15/5/5/5/5/5')

programs.intensity: No intensity column in ATHLETIC. No RIR/RPE/%, rest or tempo in the tab. Cross-reference (MASTER_MODEL sibling 'EXAMPLE ATHLETIC FULL BODY SPLI'): '*Always leave 1 rep in the tank' and 'Always go for 1-3 RIR (REPS IN RESERVE) aka RPE 7+'; 'ALL ABOUT SQUATS': hypertrophy rest 1-2 min, strength rest 3-6 min.
programs.progression_summary: OBSERVED: none - only 'WEEK 1' exists (merged A64:A70 below Sunday is empty, probably the start of an unbuilt week 2). Progression levers present in the sheet: per-slot library level ladder (FOUNDATIONAL -> MODERATE -> ADVANCED), SETS menu 1-8 (+ 'SUPERSET W/'), REPS menu '4 to 6' ... '20 Reps' + 'MYO SET'. INFERRED projection of the coach's stated 3/5/7 % weekly increments on the 2-set baseline (44 resistance sets/week over the 4 main days): week 6 = 51 / 56 / 62 sets, week 8 = 54 / 62 / 71, week 12 = 61 / 75 / 93 (compounding 3 / 5 / 7 %). At the muscle level that is +1 set every ~2.7 / 1.6 / 1.2 weeks for quads (12 sets baseline) but only every ~7.5 / 4.6 / 3.3 weeks for biceps (4 sets baseline), so percentage steps must be accumulated and released as whole sets.
